hard_gates.name: Source/provenance identity
hard_gates.constraint: Exact source, policy, Plant, input, state hashes and sealed result identity; historical records immutable

hard_gates.name: Input and comparison integrity
hard_gates.constraint: Finite non-boolean numbers, same exogenous arrays/initial physical state/timebase, no missing/duplicate frames or arbitrary time shift

hard_gates.name: Declared normalized command domain
hard_gates.constraint: Current Native and synthetic Plant normalized commands in [-1,1]; finite; no new authority

hard_gates.name: Plant mathematical domain
hard_gates.constraint: Use actual config speed 2.5..30m/s, dt=.01 and delay2; report physical accuracy UNPROVEN

hard_gates.name: Feedback/delay/reset
hard_gates.constraint: Own-arm feedback and one physical queue; reset Native/policy per actual event while preserving physical state when declared

hard_gates.name: Applicable rate/envelope contracts
hard_gates.constraint: A3 optional rate arithmetic exact when claimed; SG radius1 and sign/magnitude contract; no fabricated global rate constraint
hard_gates.source: steering_rate.py, SG source; actual downstream evidence still incomplete

hard_gates.name: A2 static necessary feasibility
hard_gates.constraint: At source envelope v5..10, static required command must fit unchanged envelope for eligible evaluation. Failure = DOMAIN_INSUFFICIENT, diagnostic only
hard_gates.source: Development fixture envelope and declared synthetic Plant equation

hard_gates.name: Execution and repeat evidence
hard_gates.constraint: Actual historical Native/Plant call evidence bound to source; exact repeated bytes; independent arithmetic; never claim new calls from trace reads
hard_gates.source: Recorded source function profiles and 65 trace pairs

hard_gates.name: Authority and publication
hard_gates.constraint: No CAN/vehicle/Params writes, ACTIVE mode, private E2/HOLDOUT access, source changes, selection or public upload

hard_gates.name: Scope and unresolved conditions
hard_gates.constraint: Unverified downstream safety/physical Plant/thresholds prevent promotion claims; only exploratory diagnostics available
hard_gates.source: Existing authority restrictions and incomplete evidence

metrics.name: curvature_rmse
metrics.definition: sqrt(mean((actual_curvature-reference_curvature)^2)), common frames
metrics.source_or_evidence: F3/F4/F5 trace and F6 independent kinematics

metrics.name: curvature_p95
metrics.definition: p95 absolute curvature error, no time shift
metrics.source_or_evidence: F3/F4/F5 trace and F6 independent kinematics

metrics.name: curvature_max
metrics.definition: maximum absolute curvature error
metrics.source_or_evidence: F3/F4/F5 trace and F6 independent kinematics

metrics.name: signed_curvature_area
metrics.definition: signed sum(error*dt), positive/negative/absolute area also mandatory
metrics.source_or_evidence: F3/F4/F5 trace and F6 independent kinematics

metrics.name: heading_error
metrics.definition: unwrapped actual-reference heading: RMS/end/absolute peak
metrics.source_or_evidence: F3/F4/F5 trace and F6 independent kinematics

metrics.name: normal_position
metrics.definition: time-aligned error projected onto reference normal: RMS/p95/maximum
metrics.source_or_evidence: F3/F4/F5 trace and F6 independent kinematics

metrics.name: along_position
metrics.definition: time-aligned error projected onto reference tangent: RMS/p95/maximum
metrics.source_or_evidence: F3/F4/F5 trace and F6 independent kinematics

metrics.name: euclidean_position
metrics.definition: time-aligned XY distance: RMS/p95/maximum
metrics.source_or_evidence: F3/F4/F5 trace and F6 independent kinematics

metrics.name: geometric_polyline_distance
metrics.definition: auxiliary closest finite reference-polyline distance; never substitutes time-aligned metrics
metrics.source_or_evidence: F3/F4/F5 trace and F6 independent kinematics

metrics.name: command_magnitude
metrics.definition: RMS/p95 absolute/maximum of delivered and applied
metrics.source_or_evidence: F5 original source; F6 time/frequency analysis

metrics.name: command_variation
metrics.source_or_evidence: F5 original source; F6 time/frequency analysis

metrics.name: command_derivative
metrics.definition: first difference/dt: RMS/p95/max, resets and transitions retained
metrics.source_or_evidence: F5 original source; F6 time/frequency analysis

metrics.name: direction_reversals
metrics.definition: nonzero sign reversals, zeros bridged; measured horizon mandatory
metrics.source_or_evidence: F5 original source; F6 time/frequency analysis

metrics.name: oscillation_spectrum
metrics.definition: full declared-window spectra, amplitude/power/mean and Parseval; full excitation identity
metrics.source_or_evidence: F5 original source; F6 time/frequency analysis

metrics.name: frequency_response
metrics.definition: identify scope/excitation/estimator; S-curve one-frequency sequence phase is descriptive only
metrics.source_or_evidence: F5 original source; F6 time/frequency analysis

metrics.name: settling_time
metrics.definition: definition/tolerance/sustained duration need explicit approval; F5 5%/1s is descriptive only
metrics.source_or_evidence: F5 original source; F6 time/frequency analysis

metrics.name: saturation_fraction
metrics.definition: exact source rail occupancy, not newly chosen near-saturation threshold
metrics.source_or_evidence: Pinned Native/A3/SG source plus immutable Plant config

metrics.name: saturation_events
metrics.definition: contiguous rail/sign runs; duration/maximum/p95 and reversals
metrics.source_or_evidence: Pinned Native/A3/SG source plus immutable Plant config

metrics.name: rate_contract_scope
metrics.definition: compare only the applicable declared source contract; native fallback not falsely certified
metrics.source_or_evidence: Pinned Native/A3/SG source plus immutable Plant config

metrics.name: lateral_acceleration
metrics.definition: both curvature*v^2 and yaw*v, named sign convention and Plant scope
metrics.source_or_evidence: Pinned Native/A3/SG source plus immutable Plant config

metrics.name: actuator_delay
metrics.definition: one declared queue; controller prediction distinguished; measured entry crossing is not settling
metrics.source_or_evidence: Pinned Native/A3/SG source plus immutable Plant config

metrics.name: reset_behavior
metrics.definition: explicit state ownership; inactive/driver flags; physical state retention by declared event
metrics.source_or_evidence: Pinned Native/A3/SG source plus immutable Plant config

metrics.name: transition_and_s_curve
metrics.definition: fixed entry/exit/reversal/ramp/S-curve inputs and complete report
metrics.source_or_evidence: F3/F4/F5 identities; gaps explicitly EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE

metrics.name: speed_and_disturbance
metrics.definition: constant-speed levels plus varying-speed/roll/measurement uncertainty evidence separately
metrics.source_or_evidence: F3/F4/F5 identities; gaps explicitly EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE

metrics.name: initial_state_coverage
metrics.definition: zero initial state and reset do not replace nonzero initial-state variation
metrics.source_or_evidence: F3/F4/F5 identities; gaps explicitly EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE

metrics.name: horizon_sensitivity
metrics.definition: common 10/20/40/80s prefixes where archived; missing = NOT_AVAILABLE
metrics.source_or_evidence: F3/F4/F5 identities; gaps explicitly EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE

metrics.name: long_term_accumulation
metrics.definition: signed integrals, heading and both position metrics over declared full horizon
metrics.source_or_evidence: F3/F4/F5 identities; gaps explicitly EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE

metrics.name: measurement_robustness
metrics.definition: noise/bias/latency/coordinate/freshness contracts require separate evidence
metrics.source_or_evidence: F3/F4/F5 identities; gaps explicitly EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE

eligibility.unusable: Vehicle-performance qualification from this synthetic cutpoint alone
eligibility.worse: Observed oscillation/bias versus some candidates; no broad vehicle conclusion
eligibility.dependency: Horizon, CP/Plant match, source reset and reference transition
eligibility.runtime_inputs: Existing Stock source; this is not a full vehicle pipeline

eligibility.usable: Diagnostic replay of unchanged development envelope at 5..10m/s
eligibility.unusable: v outside 5..10 or required static command above envelope; sharp case fails gate
eligibility.better: Lower command variation in sharp diagnostic
eligibility.dependency: Envelope calibration and dynamic demand, not just speed interpolation
eligibility.runtime_inputs: Speed/request available but approved vehicle envelope missing

eligibility.unusable: Unqualified active Runtime or vehicle promotion
eligibility.worse: Entry short-horizon position and initial signed area; some v5 tracking
eligibility.runtime_inputs: Existing optimizer has command/applied/speed; active Runtime unavailable

eligibility.usable: Exact pinned baseline source/config, ordinary projection and reset contracts
eligibility.unusable: Identity/source mismatch, malformed input, unsupported composition
eligibility.better: Variation/rate RMS lower in positive control
eligibility.dependency: Previous-output gap>1; identity region is not independent improvement
eligibility.runtime_inputs: Offline command/state available; no active Runtime authorization

eligibility.usable: F5 frozen prototype for diagnostic analysis only
eligibility.better: Some narrow metrics versus A0; continuous_s is numeric identity with A0
eligibility.worse: Rejoin signed area/position; no broad non-deterioration
eligibility.dependency: Reference exact-change trigger, 58-tick synthetic decay window, state and delay
eligibility.runtime_inputs: Current curvature/flags available; synthetic decay constant not vehicle calibration

eligibility.usable: F5 frozen prototype for cancellation/oscillation diagnostics only
eligibility.unusable: Adoption; low position RMS cannot compensate tracking/rate/saturation regression
eligibility.dependency: Causal yaw-debt gating, last selected anchor, delay and ideal measurements
eligibility.runtime_inputs: Calibrated yaw raw data exists, but LateralContext freshness/coordinate/reset binding missing

comparison.relative_non_deterioration: DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY; no automatic adoption even if all reported metrics improve

required_approvals: Separate quality-cleanup source identity and regression
